REVIEW: species_key treats stuhlmanni as a synonym of cirnei; volumes_long uses stuhlmanni. Unified to stuhlmanni to match volumes — confirm these are the same taxon.

arctic ground squirrel; MDD places parryii in Urocitellus (Spermophilus s.l. split). Body & ecology / brain mass / torpor data are all filed under the pre-split name; unified to the current name so the Evo-M1 cohort join resolves. NOTE: 39 other Spermophilus s.l. species in the compiled data still carry the pre-split genus; the full MDD split is not done.

REVIEW: tufted capuchins moved from Cebus to Sapajus (Lynch Alfaro et al. 2012); _keys species_key already resolves Reader2011 and Bortoff1993 'Cebus apella' to Sapajus apella, MacLeod2003 keeps Cebus apella. 52 compiled rows (behaviour, body_ecology, brain_mass, cortical_areas, ECV, gyrification, sensory, sleep) plus PanTHERIA sit under the old name; unified so the Evo-M1 cohort member Sapajus apella resolves. Caveat: pre-2012 'Cebus apella' sensu lato can include other Sapajus species -- confirm per source if a value looks off. Added 2026-10-15.

domestic cat, Zilles-collection label (f.d. = forma domestica); 2 values (body mass 2952 g, brain mass 29.6 g) under a label that denotes the same animal as the cohort name Felis catus. Pure nomenclature, not a wild/domestic pooling (Felis silvestris itself is NOT aliased). Added 2026-10-20.
domestic cat written as a subspecies of F. silvestris (Medina-González 2026 locomotion rows; resolver already anchors it to Felis catus, the merge kept the printed trinomial). Added 2026-10-20.

olive baboon written as a subspecies of P. cynocephalus (Young 2013 M1 surface area, Turner / Young brain mass, Mota 2015 cortical surface); same taxon as the cohort name Papio anubis. Added 2026-10-20.
